turns.text: At dusk you reach the flooded crossroads. A courier named Mira Vey is waiting by the old shrine.
I ask Mira why the royal seal on her letter has been broken.
She says riders from the Ashen Company attacked her and took the map to Dunmarrow.
We agree to recover the map before the company reaches Dunmarrow.

expected_analysis.summary: The party met courier Mira Vey at a flooded crossroads. After learning that the Ashen Company stole her map, they agreed to recover it before the company reaches Dunmarrow.

scenes.title: The courier at the crossroads
scenes.summary: The party meets Mira Vey and discovers that the Ashen Company stole a map to Dunmarrow.

scenes.title: A new objective
scenes.summary: The party agrees to recover the stolen map before the Ashen Company arrives.

review_questions.issue: Confirm the spelling of the destination: Dunmarrow.
review_questions.why_it_matters: It is the destination of the newly accepted objective and will become a campaign entity.
